questions.architecture: Layering 0 violations. core and format stay pure: sha256 and utf8 use only typed arrays and DataView. The SHA-256 rewrite is arithmetically sound. Int32Array schedule words and '| 0' are taken mod 2^32, and every intermediate sum stays below 2^53. h is still a Uint32Array, so h[i] + a wraps by ToUint32. getInt32 reads big-endian by default, and the output is still written with setUint32. Padding and writeSha256Length are unchanged. Differential runs against node:crypto matched. The UTF-8 fast path only handles units below 0x80, so surrogates and wider units still go through codePointAt and writeCodePoint. A unit after a lone high surrogate is read on its own: codePointAt returns REPLACEMENT with 1 unit, and the next index takes the fast path if it is ASCII, which is correct. Security of 42493b1: Dirent types come from libuv. On POSIX, DT_LNK is not isFile(), and Node lstat-resolves DT_UNKNOWN entries without following links. On Windows, libuv's scandir types any FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT entry (symlink, junction, other reparse tags) as a link before checking directory or file, so junctions and symlinks still go through lstat, which reports both as symbolic links, and are refused. Only DT_REG entries skip the per-entry lstat. sized() lstats each of them before any read and refuses non-regular files, and readListed opens with O_NOFOLLOW, re-checks isFile and size on the handle, and reads at most size+1 bytes, so a swap after listing is still refused. Hard links are regular files, as before. Contract handling for ADR-0211 (non-negotiable 6): the ADR is accepted, catalog.schema.json adds packs as an optional strict object (specs/schema/catalog.schema.json updated, with a drift test), dsl.api.md is updated, and the old shape is still emitted when 'core' is absent. The change is additive, so no migration is needed. The CLI --json schema (packages/cli/schemas/catalog.output.json) and MCP list_catalog are unchanged because neither passes 'core'. M18.120 changes the public editor API (saveMyShape now returns a result and takes host.available; createMyShapes requires 'available'). It is recorded in editor.api.md and the ADR-0048 amendment, and no in-repo caller outside tests exists yet. No new runtime dependency. pnpm-workspace gains a scoped override only.
